title: 选项值允许 1 个字符：「等级 A/B/C」这类选项首存不再被拒
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Maintainer ruling: objectstack-ai/cloud#5027 next-phase plan v2, decision 3 ①「选项值允许 1 个字符」, approved 2026-11-27 「同意，开工」 (rulings recorded on cloud#5027, latest seat comment).
Parent: objectstack-ai/cloud#5027, M2 (framework row).
Grading: area:data · domain:spec · Task · p2 · size S · reach: every author (human or agent) who writes a select whose natural values are single letters or digits-with-letter (grade A/B/C, size S/M/L, priority P0 only after a letter).
Dedupe: searched `option value min length`, `select option value "2 characters"`, `SystemIdentifierSchema option value`: none open. Related, closed: #19678 (form-face option values as system identifiers), #25013 (shorthand keeps what was written), #31066 (taxonomy respelling). None ruled on the 2-character floor.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：选项值现在至少 2 个字符，用户说「客户等级 A/B/C」，智能体照写 `a`、`b`、`c` 会被发布拒掉。
- 做法：只放宽选项值这一处，允许 1 个小写字母开头的字符；其它标识符的 2 字符下限不动。
- 要你做什么：无（已在 cloud#5027 计划 v2 决定 3 里批了）。

## Evidence
- cloud#5027 M1 baseline, finding 2 (Haiku 5.5 through the light door, 3 repetitions): the user asked for options A/B/C; 3/3 first saves were refused with `options.value too_small`. Haiku recovered by writing `level_a` etc., labels still A/B/C. The refusal costs one save round per such field and leaves odd stored values.
- At `origin/main` ce4d8c7d: `SelectOptionSchema.value` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` ~:382) is `SystemIdentifierSchema` (`packages/spec/src/shared/identifiers.zod.ts` ~:102, `.min(2)`, regex `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$`).

## What to do
1. Give the select option value its own schema (or a local refinement) that accepts length 1: same character rule as today (lowercase, starts with a letter, letters/digits/underscore/dot), minimum 1. ⛔ Do not change `SystemIdentifierSchema` or `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema`: they guard object, field and other machine names.
2. Find every other place that re-checks an option value with the 2-character floor and align it in the same PR: the form-face option shape (`FormSelectOptionSchema`, see #19678), the `Field.select` shorthand, picklist value schemas, runtime select validation in the data layer, the Setup option editor's client-side check, and generated JSON schemas / baselines. List each one in the PR with file:line.
3. Tests: a select with options `a`, `b`, `c` parses and publishes; `''` and `A` (uppercase) are still refused; a translation key `picklists.<name>.options.a` resolves.
4. Skill text: if `skills/**` states the 2-character floor anywhere, update that line (net 0 lines).
5. Changeset (spec patch).

## Done when
- The three tests above pass, and the PR lists every option-value check it touched.
- No other identifier's minimum length changed (show the grep).
